related.title: Kubernetes ResourceQuota：請求額度、執行用量與可排程性的差別
related.titleEn: Kubernetes ResourceQuota: admission budgets versus usage and schedulability
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：提交audit-fixture.jsonl、request-lifecycle.csv、policy-manifest.json及missing-stage.md；摘要應分列身份數、階段數和狀態覆蓋。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver audit-fixture.jsonl, request-lifecycle.csv, policy-manifest.json and missing-stage.md. The summary must distinguish identities, stage rows and response-status coverage so later reviewers cannot confuse their denominators.
related.difference: 從合成Pod清單累計CPU requests，計算新Pod是否超額；另記limits及觀測用量，禁止以低使用率繞過額度判斷。
related.differenceEn: Sum CPU requests from a synthetic Pod inventory and decide whether a new Pod exceeds quota. Record limits and observed utilization separately; low current usage must not bypass the admission-budget calculation.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: Kubernetes稽核政策可選事件層級及省略階段；缺少ResponseComplete不能單獨證明請求失敗，也可能是政策、長連線或收集缺口。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 100個請求ID：80個各有Received與Complete兩列、10個只有Received、10個只有Complete；合計180列，Complete可觀測90個。 請求身份為100而非180；完成階段可觀測率90/100=90%，不是API成功率，因為尚未查看回應狀態。

ResourceQuota限制命名空間累計宣告資源與物件；配額允許不等於Pod一定能排程，且配額不是資料存取授權或機密隔離。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 配額requests.cpu為8核心，現有10個Pod各要求0.6核心，合計6；新Pod要求2.5，觀測CPU只有2核心但不參與額度相加。 新總請求8.5核心，超額0.5，所以本例拒絕；若新要求改2核心，總數8剛好符合該配額。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Kubernetes audit policy selects levels and may omit stages. A missing ResponseComplete record alone does not prove request failure; policy choices, long-running requests and collection gaps are alternative explanations. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. One hundred request identities contain eighty Received/Complete pairs, ten Received-only records and ten Complete-only records. There are 180 rows and ninety identities with an observed completion record. Request identity count is 100 rather than 180. Completion-stage observability is 90/100=90%; this is not the API success rate because response-status outcomes have not yet been evaluated.

ResourceQuota constrains aggregate declared resources and objects in a namespace. Passing quota admission does not guarantee schedulability, and quota is neither data-access authorization nor a confidentiality boundary. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. The requests.cpu quota is eight cores. Ten existing Pods each request 0.6, totaling six; a new Pod requests 2.5. Observed use is only two cores but is excluded from quota arithmetic. The proposed total is 8.5 cores, exceeding quota by 0.5, so this fixture rejects admission. Reducing the new request to two cores produces a total of eight, satisfying that quota.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Google SRE：多視窗error-budget burn與恢復後告警解除
related.titleEn: Google SRE: multiwindow error-budget burn and alert reset after recovery
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：提交audit-fixture.jsonl、request-lifecycle.csv、policy-manifest.json及missing-stage.md；摘要應分列身份數、階段數和狀態覆蓋。

The summary must distinguish identities, stage rows and response-status coverage so later reviewers cannot confuse their denominators.
related.difference: 從相同請求定義計算長短視窗錯誤比例與burn rate，明確實作兩視窗同時超標的教學條件，保留無流量為未知。
related.differenceEn: Calculate error ratios and burn rates from consistent request definitions in long and short windows. Implement the explicit teaching condition that both windows exceed threshold, keeping zero-traffic windows unknown.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.

SRE以相對SLO允許錯誤比例的速率描述burn；多視窗可檢查錯誤是否持續。下面固定流量假設只用於把一小時消耗映射到30日預算。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 SLO99.9%，允許比例0.001；長窗1小時錯誤0.01，短窗5分鐘錯誤0.002；教學門檻兩窗burn都大於6，期間720小時。 長窗burn=0.01/0.001=10，短窗2未過6；固定流量下一小時消耗10/720=1.388889%的總預算。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Kubernetes audit policy selects levels and may omit stages. A missing ResponseComplete record alone does not prove request failure; policy choices, long-running requests and collection gaps are alternative explanations. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. One hundred request identities contain eighty Received/Complete pairs, ten Received-only records and ten Complete-only records. There are 180 rows and ninety identities with an observed completion record. Request identity count is 100 rather than 180. Completion-stage observability is 90/100=90%; this is not the API success rate because response-status outcomes have not yet been evaluated.

SRE burn rate compares observed error fraction with the fraction permitted by the SLO. Multiple windows check whether errors continue; constant traffic is assumed only when mapping one hour of consumption to a thirty-day budget. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. The SLO is 99.9%, allowing an error fraction of 0.001. The one-hour ratio is 0.01 and five-minute ratio 0.002; the teaching threshold requires both burn rates above six over a 720-hour period. Long-window burn is 0.01/0.001=10, while short-window burn is two and fails the threshold. Under constant traffic, that hour consumes 10/720=1.388889% of the total budget.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
